memories.text: The cold vault runs at four degrees and thirty-eight percent humidity, and the logger on the north wall reads a full degree colder than the one by the door.
Opened a can from the 1963 accession and found the leader had been spliced with masking tape by somebody who clearly meant well in about 1985.
Decided to scan the sixteen millimetre reel wet-gate at four K rather than dry at two K, which triples the time but hides the base scratches completely.
The landlord's cat Marguerite came in through the balcony door again and fell asleep on the box of my grandmother's letters.
A researcher from Ghent emailed asking for the twelve minutes of Expo 67 street footage, and I had to tell her that reel is on the vinegar watch list.
I am translating my grandmother Zdenka's letters from Czech at a rate of about one a week, and I am currently stuck on a word that might be a nickname.
Exposed six cyanotypes of fern fronds on the balcony and the fifth one blew off the board into the alley before it had washed.
The barista at Cafe Olimpico told me my macchiato order has been identical for four years and asked whether I was ever going to try anything else.
Cycled up to the Jean-Talon market before the crowds and bought a flat of Quebec strawberries that turned out to be two days past their best.
Decided to re-house the entire 1970s newsreel series in vented polypropylene cans instead of the original metal, starting with the forty-one worst ones.
The orange line was stopped at Berri for eight minutes because of a signal fault and the whole platform emptied onto the street to walk instead.
There are two hundred and six cans on the vinegar watch list and eleven of them moved a full step on the A-D strips this quarter.
Decided the autumn screening programme opens with the restored ferry footage rather than the parade reel, because the ferry has sound and the parade does not.
Found a handwritten shot list folded inside can number thirty-one, dated the ninth of March 1968, and photographed it before I touched anything else.
My colleague Sylvie insisted the projector for the screening needs a new xenon lamp and I insisted it needs a new operator, and we both laughed but she is right.
Walked from Place-d'Armes in the rain without an umbrella and arrived with the notebook in my jacket completely dry and everything else soaked.
The wet-gate scan of the sixteen millimetre reel is at fifty-two percent this morning and will not finish until sometime after four in the afternoon.
Decided to keep the original masking tape splice in the archive box as an artefact rather than throw it out, and labelled the envelope with the date it was found.
